name: Hayama Takako
source:
Deputy dorm head and roommate of Temari. She is a serious and inflexible member of the public discipline committee, but she is very sweet to Temari.

She is always concerned about Temari and is very overprotective. She has known Temari since they were children. She always stands by Temari's side and helps her.

She is well versed in various martial arts and is rumored to be the strongest in the school and is seen riding her bicycle at high speed with Temari on board.

[From [url=https://www.pulltop.com/gp07/02_chara06-01.html]official site[/url]]
